evidence.description: The static shared instance exposes mutable statistics properties without an isolation or synchronization boundary.
The asynchronous fetchAndUpdate method directly mutates treesPlanted and treesPlantedLastUpdated after fetching and decoding data.
The same method directly updates the remaining shared instance statistics without synchronization.

candidates.explanation: Statistics exposes mutable instance state through its static shared instance. The properties are readable publicly and updated by fetchAndUpdate without any visible actor isolation or synchronization. The immutable shared reference does not protect the mutable state of the referenced instance.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
